full_prompt_en: A square graphic illustration depicts a quiet dusk encounter using broad flat color fields and exact shadow shapes. At the left, a pale warm-cream building wall catches low sunlight; its single tall narrow doorway is a dark teal recess with a slim coral inner edge. A deep blue shadow plane wraps around the building and extends across the ground. Near the lower middle, two small figures sit beside one another in silhouette, with no facial detail. At the right, a large tree becomes a dense near-black canopy and trunk, partly masking a round golden sun against a desaturated teal sky. The lower foreground is dominated by a broad blue-black shadow, while a strip of sunlit ground cuts across the center, leading the eye toward the figures. The illustration is remarkably economical: the building is nearly a pure rectangle, the sun a pure circle, the people simple dark shapes, and the tree a textured edge to the geometric scheme. Slight grain and delicate irregularity give the flat surfaces a tactile printed character. Strong warm-cool separation pairs cream and orange light with teal and midnight-blue shade, alongside long low-angle shadows. The mood is spacious and intimate at once, a moment of still conversation held inside an almost architectural arrangement of color.
full_prompt_zh: 正方形黄昏平面插画以宽广纯色面和精确影形表现安静相遇。左侧一面暖乳白建筑墙接住低角度日光；唯一的高窄门洞是深青色凹处，内缘有一道细珊瑚红。深蓝阴影包围建筑并横越地面。下方中央附近，两道小人影并肩坐着，没有面部细节。右侧的大树化作近黑色密集树冠和树干，遮住青绿色低饱和天空中的部分金黄圆日。下部前景由宽阔蓝黑阴影占据，中段一条阳光照亮的地面引导视线到人物。插画保持极其经济：建筑几乎是纯长方形，太阳是纯圆，人物为简化深色形状，树则为几何秩序提供有纹理的边缘。少量颗粒和细微不规则赋予平涂表面可触摸的印刷质感。暖冷分离鲜明，以乳白和橙色光对照青色与午夜蓝阴影，投影低而长。气氛既开阔又亲密，一段静止交谈被容纳在近似建筑设计的色彩布局里。
style_prompt_en: Graphic editorial illustration combines broad matte color planes, exact geometry, tiny silhouetted scale accents and long decisive shadows. Pale cream and golden-orange light contrast with desaturated teal and near-black blue shade. Circles and rectangles form primary anchors, interrupted by one softly irregular organic edge. Sparse arrangement, ample dark negative space, minimal detail and faint print grain characterize the square composition. Strong flat-value contrast coexists with quiet warmth, while distance and light carry the visual narrative.
style_prompt_zh: 平面编辑插画结合宽广哑光色面、精确几何、微小剪影尺度重音与果断长影。浅乳白、金橙亮部与低饱和青色及近黑蓝影形成对照。圆形和长方形构成主要视觉锚点，一处柔软不规则的有机边缘打断几何秩序。稀疏布局、大面积深色留白、极少细节与淡淡印刷颗粒构成正方形画面。强烈平涂明暗对照与安静暖意并存，距离和光线承载视觉叙事。
theme_en: Two small figures at sunset beside a pale geometric building
theme_zh: 夕阳下浅色几何建筑旁的两个人影
name: Malika Favre
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
